about.title: About League Electric
text: League Electric is your trusted partner for all things electrical in Waco, TX, and the surrounding areas. Since 2020, we've been lighting up homes and businesses with our exceptional skills and dedication to customer satisfaction. Our team of experienced electricians is ready to tackle any electrical challenge, from simple repairs to complex installations.

Whether you're a homeowner upgrading your panel or a business outfitting a new commercial space, League Electric delivers results you can count on. We believe in doing the job right the first time and standing by our work with transparent pricing and dependable service.

Our electricians are fully licensed, insured, and trained in the latest industry standards to keep your systems safe and efficient. We also offer free estimates and flexible scheduling to make your experience as hassle-free as possible. When you choose League Electric, you're choosing quality, experience, and a team that truly cares about your electrical needs.
